sources.author: W. H. Zurek
sources.title: Environment-Assisted Invariance, Causality, and Probabilities in Quantum Physics
sources.exact_statement: I introduce environment-assisted invariance -- a symmetry related to causality that is exhibited by correlated quantum states -- and describe how it can be used to understand the nature of ignorance and, hence, the origin of probabilities in quantum physics.
sources.notes: Author explicitly claims origin of probabilities via envariance symmetry.

sources.author: David Wallace
sources.title: A formal proof of the Born rule from decision-theoretic assumptions
sources.exact_statement: I develop the decision-theoretic approach to quantum probability, originally proposed by David Deutsch, into a mathematically rigorous proof of the Born rule in (Everett-interpreted) quantum mechanics. I sketch the argument informally, then prove it formally, and lastly consider a number of proposed ``counter-examples'' to show exactly which premises of the argument they violate.
sources.notes: Author claims a formal proof under decision-theoretic assumptions and explicitly identifies premises violated by counter-examples.
